name: jacoelho
description: Personal skills, subagents and hooks (prompt intake, context handoff): Go API design and performance, testing, specs, architecture review, technical writing.

intake_effort.title: Prompt intake: effort
intake_effort.description: How hard the session's model thinks when it sorts an intake: message. Thinking counts toward the reply cap, which grows with effort (low 4096, medium 8192, higher 16384 tokens) and is reserved against your output-token rate limit, so higher levels are slower and more likely to hit a 429.

handoff_offer_at.title: Handoff: offer at (% of auto-compact)
handoff_offer_at.description: Show the handoff offer when context reaches this percent of the auto-compact threshold (the model's window when auto-compact is off). 0 turns the offer off.

handoff_on_compact.title: Handoff: on compaction
handoff_on_compact.description: core: Claude Code compacts as usual. handoff: manual and auto compaction write a handoff and the transcript becomes that handoff; on any failure Claude Code compacts as usual.

handoff_prompt_file.title: Handoff: prompt file
handoff_prompt_file.description: Path to the handoff prompt (~ allowed). Empty: the prompt bundled at hooks/handoff/prompts/handoff.md. Placeholder: {{cwd}}.

handoff_dir.title: Handoff: save folder
handoff_dir.description: Where handoffs and handoff.log are saved (~ allowed). Empty: ~/.claude/handoffs.

implement_model_planner.title: Spec implementation: planner model
implement_model_planner.description: Model for the planner, which plans, resumes, closes, and takes a unit's last attempt. inherit: the session's model.

implement_model_test_writer.title: Spec implementation: test writer model
implement_model_test_writer.description: Model for the test writer, which writes each change's failing tests. inherit: the session's model.

implement_model_implementer.title: Spec implementation: implementer model
implement_model_implementer.description: Model for the implementer, which implements units and fixes failing checks. inherit: the session's model.

implement_model_runner.title: Spec implementation: runner model
implement_model_runner.description: Model for the runner, which hashes contracts and runs checks. inherit: the session's model.

implement_model_reviewer.title: Spec implementation: reviewer model
implement_model_reviewer.description: Model for the reviewer, which checks conformance to the contracts and the design. inherit: the session's model.

implement_model_recorder.title: Spec implementation: recorder model
implement_model_recorder.description: Model for the recorder, which writes the implementation record. inherit: the session's model.
